scenes.notes: Series sting, reused in every S01 episode. Border closes in, stamp lands.

narration.en: Everyone knows Karna's wheel sank. Few ask why.
narration.hi: कर्ण का पहिया धँसा, सब जानते हैं। क्यों धँसा, कम लोग पूछते हैं।

scenes.notes: Close on a chariot wheel, half swallowed by cracked red earth.
Pull back: Karna, both hands on it, cannot lift it.

narration.en: It began with a lie, a cow, and an insect.
narration.hi: वजह थी: एक झूठ, एक गाय, और एक कीड़ा।

scenes.notes: Trailer 1/3, the lie: close on Karna's joined palms and a glance aside.
Trailer 2/3: the cow, alive and garlanded, a bell at her neck.
Trailer 3/3: the insect (Shanti 3: eight feet, fangs, needle bristles), very close.

narration.en: To match Arjuna, Karna asked Drona for the Brahmastra. Drona refused.
narration.hi: अर्जुन की बराबरी के लिए कर्ण ने द्रोण से ब्रह्मास्त्र माँगा। द्रोण ने मना कर दिया।

scenes.notes: Arjuna draws; Karna watches from behind. Shanti 2 (CE 12.2.9).
Karna asks; the weapon glows between them; Drona's palm says no. CE 12.2.9-13.

narration.en: So he went to Parashurama, and lied: "I am a Brahmin."
narration.hi: तो वो परशुराम के पास गए, और झूठ बोले: "मैं ब्राह्मण हूँ।"

scenes.notes: Plain student's cloth, no crown: he has come disguised. CE 12.2.14-16.
Close: he says it. Lip-sync on the quote.

narration.en: One day he killed a Brahmin's cow by accident, and begged forgiveness.
narration.hi: एक दिन अनजाने में उन्होंने एक ब्राह्मण की गाय मार दी, और क्षमा माँगी।

scenes.notes: He practises by the sea; far off, half hidden by dunes, a cow. The arrow is in the air. No hit shown. CE 12.2.19-20 (arrow: Karna Parva 8.29.33).
A bell and a broken garland on the sand between them: all we see of the death. He owns up and begs. CE 12.2.21-22.

narration.en: But the Brahmin cursed him: "When you face your rival, the earth will swallow your wheel. Careless, you killed her. Careless, you'll die."
narration.hi: पर ब्राह्मण ने शाप दिया: "जिससे तेरी होड़ है, उससे लड़ते समय धरती तेरा पहिया निगलेगी। असावधानी में मारा है, असावधानी में मरेगा।"

scenes.notes: The Brahmin, waist-up. First stamp. CE 12.2.23-26.
His words as a vision between them: a wheel drawn in light sinks into the sand; the Brahmin speaks, Karna is bowed.

narration.en: Still, Parashurama taught him the weapon.
narration.hi: फिर भी परशुराम ने उन्हें ब्रह्मास्त्र सिखा दिया।

scenes.notes: The weapon as a blazing ring between guru and pupil. CE 12.3.1-3.

narration.en: One day his guru slept with his head in Karna's lap. An insect bored into Karna's thigh. To let him sleep, Karna didn't move.
narration.hi: एक दिन गुरु उनकी गोद में सिर रखकर सोए थे। एक कीड़ा कर्ण की जाँघ में घुसने लगा। गुरु न जागें, इसलिए कर्ण हिले तक नहीं।

scenes.notes: Karna seated cross-legged; Parashurama asleep in front of him, his head in Karna's lap. CE 12.3.4-5.
Close: the insect on the folded cloth over his thigh, one thin red line. No wound. CE 12.3.6-7.
Close: jaw clenched, one tear, not a tremor. CE 12.3.8-9.

narration.en: His blood woke him. "No Brahmin could bear such pain. Tell me the truth!"
narration.hi: ख़ून छूते ही गुरु जाग गए: "इतना दर्द कोई ब्राह्मण नहीं सह सकता। सच बता!"

scenes.notes: Parashurama is on his feet. CE 12.3.10-11, 24-25.
Close on his eyes.

narration.en: "I'm a charioteer's son." The second curse fell: "You lied for this weapon. At the hour of your death, it will fail you."
narration.hi: "मैं सूतपुत्र हूँ।" और दूसरा शाप मिला: "इस अस्त्र के लिए तूने झूठ बोला। मृत्यु की घड़ी में ये साथ नहीं देगा।"

scenes.notes: Waist-up: he tells the truth. CE 12.3.26-28.
Second stamp. CE 12.3.29-31.

narration.en: At Kurukshetra, facing Arjuna, both curses came due. The wheel sank. The weapon wouldn't come.
narration.hi: कुरुक्षेत्र में, अर्जुन के सामने, दोनों शाप साथ फले। पहिया धँस गया। अस्त्र प्रकट न हुआ।

scenes.notes: The duel. CE 8.66.
Curse 1: the hook's image again. CE 8.66.42.
Curse 2: he calls; the ring above his palm stays dark and cracked. CE 8.66.42.

narration.en: While the wheel held him, as the Brahmin had said, Arjuna's arrow struck.
narration.hi: कर्ण पहिये में उलझे थे, और जैसा ब्राह्मण ने कहा था, अर्जुन का बाण आ लगा।

scenes.notes: CE 8.67.23, "cakre visaktam".
We stay on Arjuna; the arrow leaves and the screen goes white. The death itself isn't shown.

narration.en: A cow killed by accident took his wheel. A lie exposed by an insect took his weapon.
narration.hi: अनजाने में मरी गाय ने पहिया छीना। और कीड़े से खुले झूठ ने, अस्त्र।

scenes.notes: The cow's bell on the sand.
The wheel, alone now.
The insect from the trailer.
The dark ring, and the light that rose from Karna (CE 8.67.27).

narration.en: Next: the king of heaven who became a snake.
narration.hi: अगली बार: स्वर्ग का वो राजा, जो साँप बन गया।

scenes.notes: Tease for E06: a crowned king whose shadow is a serpent (Nahusha, CE 5.17.11-16).
